text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I brought <chrname> 
to the infirmary for a checkup—

Oh, right here, right here! Welco—er, not 
customer, 
student!

An injury? Feeling sick? Or maybe some 
mental care? 
Well, leave it all to me, no sweat!

Huh? Well, since I'm in the infirmary, I'm 
obviously... 
a slightly fantastic school nurse? Or 
somethin'?

Ahaha, yeah, figures you wouldn't buy 
that. 
Guess I'll just introduce myself normally.
*Ahem!* Truth be told, none other than—

The savior who (probably) guides countless 
horsegirls! 
The (self-proclaimed) legendary 
acupuncturist with miraculous hands!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And my name is Sasami Anshinzawa!! 
Whoa, reee~lax☆!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I'm terribly sorry. 
I'm embarrassed to say, I'm unfamiliar 
with that name... 
Are you well-known here in the city?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Whoa, someone does not look reee~laxed☆!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, now, now, first things first. 
Introductions are out of the way, so how 
'bout we poke you right in?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no thank you...! 
I appreciate the thought, but...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Nothin' to be scared of! 
I'm just gonna poke a secret pressure 
point with my secret bamboo needle.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And when I do, BAM! Power up! Zoom! Energy 
boost! 
Basically, somethin' amaaaazing's gonna 
happen!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Just so you know, there's nothin' 
sketchy about me! 
I've never failed even once!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...My master, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, this is technically my first 
job, so 
broadly speaking, I've never failed 
either!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I spent ten whole years making 
tea for— 
I mean, training under my legendary 
master!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Whoa, reee~lax☆!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was no way I could go along with 
this. 
I took <chrname> by the hand 
and moved to leave, but—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, wait, wait, hold on a sec!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're Daring Tact, right?! 
A heart and body forged in the great 
outdoors! 
The pure, strong, beautiful child of 
pristine white!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Course I do! I've seen her!! 
I'm a fan, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I came here to cheer you guys on! 
To lend a helpin' hand, believe it or 
not!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So pleeeaaase~~!! 
Give me a shot, will ya~~?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! 
You've been cheering for me?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Please, please, please! 
I'll even let you pick which pressure 
point to hit!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I de~finitely won't mess up~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Probably.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, like, definitely-adjacent to 
probably? Somethin' like that? 
...Anyway, don't sweat the small stuff!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, which pressure point do 
you wanna aim for?! 
Stat boost, health boost... 
I can even give you a charm boost!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It reeked of terrifying danger, but 
maybe, just maybe, there was a slight 
chance 
it could have an incredible effect... or 
not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What should we do...?
choice_data_list:
Aim for the pressure point to become a 
stronger horsegirl
Aim for the pressure point to win races

Aim for the pressure point for vibrant 
health
Aim for the pressure point to boost charm
It's too risky, so let's pass

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Right, right, 
"become a stronger horsegirl," got it!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here comes the poke! You sure 
about this? 
...Are you reeeeeeally, truly sure?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Okey-doke, leave it to me! 
Come forth, bamboo needle! Reveal 
yourself, pressure point!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Now just relax~... Whoa, reee~lax☆!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: *Jab!!*

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bullseye, huge success!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Th-This is...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
My body feels so light. 
Body and soul—it's like having wings!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, it worked? Seriously?! Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay~~!! 
How did I even do that~?!?! 
I'm a geniuuuus~~!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> was overflowing with 
an unmistakable surge of power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she had grasped new potential. 
I could feel we had taken a huge leap 
toward her dream...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, right now... 
I don't think it's a good idea for me to 
move...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> had visibly 
fallen into terrible shape...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Ah~... Well, um... you know?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, byeeee~☆!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should never have listened to that 
sketchy offer... 
I was left with nothing but deep regret.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa

"aim for the pressure point to win races," 
got it!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now just relax and let go... Whew, relief

text_block_list.text: Take this jab!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A direct hit! Massive success!

Body and mind both—it's like having wings!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, it worked? Seriously?! Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No wayyyy!! 
How on earth did I pull that off?!?!?! 
I'm a genius~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I could feel a dramatic improvement 
in <chrname>'s technique!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she seized her potential. 
I felt her take a giant leap forward 
toward her dreams...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, right now... 
it's probably best if I don't try to 
move...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> was visibly unwell...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Ah~... Well, uh... you know?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, time to fly~☆

on academy grounds, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa

text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, retreat~☆

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:

If I had encountered her in the mountains, 
I might have chased after her 
instinctively.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
However, since we are on academy grounds, 
we should leave this to Tazuna.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Who on earth was Anshinzawa...? 
Realizing there was no point dwelling on 
it, 
I decided to put today's incident out of 
my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oopsie-daisy, misclicked? 
Well, happens to the best of us, totally 
get it!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Alright, tell me one more time. 
Which pressure point are we going for?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, keeping me in suspense~?! 
Wait, no, if we drag our feet like this—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa

on academy grounds, aren't you?!

text_block_list.text:
...By the time we finished hesitating, 
the whole situation had somehow fizzled 
out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What was that even about...? 
<chrname> and I looked at each other 
and tilted our heads in bewilderment.

title: The Reee~laxing Acupuncturist Makes Her Grand☆Entrance
